title: LCM: Lossless Context Management
summary:
We introduce Lossless Context Management (LCM), a deterministic architecture for LLM memory that outperforms Claude Code on long-context tasks. When benchmarked using Opus 4.6, our LCM-augmented coding agent, Volt, achieves higher scores than Claude Code on the OOLONG long-context eval, including at every context length between 32K and 1M tokens.
  LCM may be considered both a vindication and extension of the recursive paradigm pioneered by Recursive Language Models (RLMs). Our results demonstrate that recursive context manipulation can outperform not just conventional LLMs, but frontier coding agents with native file-system access.
  LCM departs from RLM by decomposing symbolic recursion into two deterministic, engine-managed mechanisms: recursive context compression, in which a hierarchical summary DAG automatically compacts older messages while retaining lossless pointers to every original; and recursive task partitioning, in which engine-managed parallel primitives like LLM-Map replace model-written loops. This trade-off, analogous to the move from GOTO to structured control flow in program-ming language design, sacrifices maximal flexibility for termination guarantees, zero-cost continuity on short tasks, and lossless retrievability of all prior state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lossless Context Management (LCM)，一种确定性LLM记忆架构，通过递归上下文压缩和递归任务分解，在长上下文任务上超越Claude Code，在OOLONG评估中所有上下文长度（32K至1M tokens）均取得更高分数。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在处理长上下文时存在性能下降、上下文丢失、无法保证终止等问题，亟需一种既能高效管理长上下文又能保证无损可检索性的架构。
AI.method: LCM将符号递归分解为两种确定性机制：1) 递归上下文压缩——构建层级摘要DAG，自动压缩旧消息同时保留指向原始内容的无损指针；2) 递归任务分解——引擎管理的并行原语（如LLM-Map）取代模型编写的循环，实现结构化控制流。
AI.result: 基于Opus 4.6的LCM增强编码代理Volt在OOLONG长上下文评估中全面超越Claude Code，在32K到1M tokens各上下文长度下均获得更高分数。
AI.conclusion: LCM证明了递归上下文操作可以超越传统LLM甚至具有本地文件系统访问的前沿编码代理，从GOTO到结构化控制流的类比表明在灵活性与确定性保证之间取得了有效平衡。
idea_en: Hierarchical summary DAG with lossless pointers for LLM context compression, enabling automatic compaction of old messages while maintaining complete retrievability of original content.
Engine-managed parallel primitives (LLM-Map) replacing model-written loops for recursive task partitioning, providing termination guarantees and zero-cost continuity.
Deterministic recursive context manipulation architecture that separates symbolic recursion into two engine-managed mechanisms for guaranteed termination and lossless state retrieval.
Lossless pointer-based context retrieval system that maintains references to all original content within a compressed hierarchical summary structure.

title: Regularized Centered Emphatic Temporal Difference Learning
summary: Off-policy temporal-difference (TD) learning with function approximation faces a structural tradeoff among stability, projection geometry, and variance control. Emphatic TD (ETD) improves the off-policy projection geometry through follow-on emphasis, but the follow-on trace can have high variance. We revisit this tradeoff through Bellman-error centering. Although centering naturally removes a common drift term from TD errors, we show that a naive centered emphatic extension introduces an auxiliary coupling that can destroy the positive-definiteness of the ETD key matrix. We propose \emph{Regularized Emphatic Temporal-Difference Learning} (RETD), which preserves the follow-on trace and regularizes only the auxiliary centering recursion, corresponding to lifting the lower-right block of the coupled key matrix from \(1\) to \(1+c\). We derive the RETD core matrix, prove convergence under a conservative sufficient regularization condition, and evaluate the method on diagnostic linear off-policy prediction tasks. The experiments show that RETD avoids the instability of naive centered emphatic learning, preserves favorable emphatic geometry, and exhibits a robust intermediate regime for the regularization parameter \(c\) across the diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出正则化强调时序差分学习(RETD)，通过仅正则化辅助中心化递归项来平衡离策略TD学习中的稳定性、投影几何和方差控制问题，在不破坏强调TD核心矩阵正定性的前提下改善性能。
AI.motivation: 离策略TD学习在函数逼近下存在稳定性、投影几何和方差控制之间的结构性权衡。强调TD(ETD)通过后续强调改善了离策略投影几何，但后续迹存在高方差问题。作者重新审视这一权衡，发现朴素中心化强调扩展会引入辅助耦合，破坏ETD关键矩阵的正定性。
AI.method: 提出正则化强调时序差分学习(RETD)：保留后续迹，仅对辅助中心化递归项进行正则化，将耦合关键矩阵的右下角块从1提升到1+c。推导了RETD核心矩阵，并证明了在保守充分正则化条件下的收敛性。
AI.result: 实验表明：RETD避免了朴素中心化强调学习的不稳定性，保留了有利的强调几何特性，在诊断任务中正则化参数c表现出稳健的中间区间。
AI.conclusion: RETD通过选择性地正则化中心化项，在不破坏ETD核心矩阵正定性的前提下，有效解决了离策略TD学习中的稳定性与几何权衡问题。
idea_en: Regularized Emphatic Temporal-Difference Learning (RETD): A method that selectively regularizes only the auxiliary centering recursion while preserving the follow-on trace, lifting the lower-right block of the coupled key matrix from 1 to 1+c to maintain positive-definiteness.
Bellman-error centering for off-policy TD learning: A technique that naturally removes common drift terms from TD errors, analyzed in the context of emphatic TD methods.
Coupled key matrix analysis: A theoretical framework for analyzing the coupling effect between the TD update direction and the auxiliary centering recursion in emphatic TD learning.
Selective regularization strategy: Regularizing only the centering recursion component (not the follow-on trace) to avoid destroying the positive-definiteness of the ETD key matrix.
Conservative sufficient regularization condition: A convergence guarantee for RETD under a specific regularization condition that ensures stability while preserving emphatic geometry.
idea_ch: 正则化强调时序差分学习(RETD)：选择性仅对辅助中心化递归进行正则化，同时保留后续迹，将耦合关键矩阵右下角块从1提升到1+c以维持正定性。

保守充分正则化条件：在特定正则化条件下保证RETD收敛，同时保持强调几何特性的收敛性证明。

title: Actionable Real-Time Modeling of Surgical Team Dynamics via Time-Expanded Interaction Graphs
comment: Accepted at Hybrid Human Artificial Intelligence (HHAI) 2026
summary: Surgical team performance arises from complex interactions between technical execution and non-technical skills, including communication and coordination dynamics. However, current surgical AI systems predominantly model visual workflow signals, lacking structured representations of intraoperative team interactions over time. We propose a real-time actionable approach for modeling surgical team dynamics using time-expanded interaction graphs, where team members are modeled as time-indexed nodes and communication exchanges define directed edges. This spatio-temporal expansion enables dynamic interaction modeling, while allowing efficient inference with a static graph neural network. The model predicts procedural efficiency as the deviation from the expected duration and supports real-time deployment. Beyond prediction, we perform a counterfactual analysis to identify minimal changes in communication structure and interpretable behavioral variables associated with improved predicted outcomes. Experiments on recorded surgical procedures show that structured modeling of team interactions improves early identification of prolonged interventions and provides coherent, actionable explanations. This work advances surgical AI toward real-time, team-aware, and actionable decision support in the operating room.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于时间扩展交互图（Time-Expanded Interaction Graphs）的实时手术团队动态建模方法，将团队成员建模为时间索引节点、通信关系定义为有向边，利用静态图神经网络进行高效推理，预测手术效率偏差，并通过反事实分析提供可解释的改进建议。
AI.motivation: 现有手术AI系统主要建模视觉工作流信号，缺乏对术中团队交互（沟通与协作动态）的结构化表示，无法充分理解手术团队表现的非技术因素。
AI.method: 构建时间扩展交互图：团队成员为时间索引节点，通信交换为有向边；采用静态图神经网络对时空动态进行高效推理；通过反事实分析识别通信结构的最小变化以改善预测结果。
AI.result: 实验表明，结构化建模团队交互可改善对手术时间延长干预的早期识别，并提供连贯、可操作的解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推动手术AI向实时、团队感知、可操作决策支持方向发展。
idea_en: A method for modeling surgical team dynamics in real-time using time-expanded interaction graphs, where team members are represented as time-indexed nodes and communication exchanges define directed edges, enabling dynamic interaction modeling with static graph neural network inference.

A counterfactual analysis technique for identifying minimal changes in communication structure and interpretable behavioral variables associated with improved surgical procedure efficiency predictions.

A system for predicting procedural efficiency deviation from expected duration based on structured modeling of intraoperative team interaction dynamics, supporting real-time deployment in operating rooms.

title: ANDRE: An Attention-based Neuro-symbolic Differentiable Rule Extractor
summary: Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) aims to learn interpretable first-order rules from data, but existing symbolic and neuro-symbolic approaches struggle to scale to noisy and probabilistic settings. Classical ILP relies on discrete combinatorial rule search and is brittle under uncertainty, while differentiable ILP methods typically depend on predefined rule templates or inaccurate fuzzy operators that suffer from vanishing gradients or poor approximation of logical structure when reasoning over probabilistic predicate valuations. This paper proposes an Attention-based Neuro-symbolic Differentiable Rule Extractor (ANDRE), a novel ILP framework that learns first-order logic programs by optimizing over a continuous rule space with attention-based logical operators. ANDRE replaces both rule templates and logical operators with fully differentiable, attention-driven conjunction and disjunction operators that approximate logical min-max semantics, enabling accurate, stable, and interpretable reasoning over probabilistic data. By softly selecting, negating, or excluding predicates within each rule, ANDRE supports flexible rule induction while preserving symbolic structure. Extensive experiments on classical ILP benchmarks, large-scale knowledge bases, and synthetic datasets with probabilistic predicates and noisy supervision demonstrate that ANDRE achieves competitive or superior predictive performance while reliably recovering correct symbolic rules under uncertainty. In particular, ANDRE remains robust to moderate label noise, substantially outperforming existing differentiable ILP methods in both rule extraction quality and stability.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于注意力的神经符号可微规则提取器（ANDRE），通过注意力驱动的逻辑算子在连续规则空间中优化，实现从概率数据中学习一阶逻辑规则。
AI.motivation: 现有归纳逻辑编程方法在处理噪声和概率数据时存在局限：传统符号方法依赖离散组合搜索且脆弱，可微ILP方法依赖预定义规则模板或不准确的模糊算子，导致梯度消失或逻辑结构近似不佳。
AI.method: ANDRE使用完全可微的、基于注意力的合取和析取算子替代规则模板和逻辑算子，近似逻辑min-max语义，支持对谓词进行软选择、否定或排除，在连续规则空间中优化学习一阶逻辑程序。
AI.result: 在经典ILP基准、大规模知识库和含噪声概率谓词的合成数据集上，ANDRE在预测性能和符号规则恢复质量上达到或超越现有方法，对中等标签噪声具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ANDRE通过注意力机制实现了可微ILP中准确、稳定和可解释的概率数据推理，在规则提取质量和稳定性上显著优于现有可微ILP方法。

Noise-robust differentiable ILP method that reliably recovers symbolic rules under probabilistic and noisy supervision

title: Pro$^2$Assist: Continuous Step-Aware Proactive Assistance with Multimodal Egocentric Perception for Long-Horizon Procedural Tasks
summary: Procedural tasks with multiple ordered steps are ubiquitous in daily life. Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled personal assistants that support daily activities. However, existing systems primarily provide reactive guidance triggered by user queries, or limited proactive assistance for isolated short-term events rather than long-horizon procedural tasks. In this work, we introduce Pro$^2$Assist, a step-aware proactive assistant that continuously tracks fine-grained task progress and reasons over the user's evolving state to provide timely assistance throughout tasks. Pro$^2$Assist leverages multimodal data from augmented reality (AR) glasses to achieve motion-based perception. It then extracts step-oriented procedural context from multi-scale temporal dynamics and task-specific expert knowledge. Based on both sensory input and procedural context, Pro$^2$Assist performs continuous reasoning to infer user needs and display timely assistance on AR glasses. We evaluate Pro$^2$Assist using a dataset curated from public sources and a real-world dataset collected on our testbed with AR glasses. Extensive evaluations show that Pro$^2$Assist outperforms the best-performing baselines by over 21% in procedural action understanding accuracy, and it achieves up to 2.29x the proactive timing accuracy of baselines. A user study with 20 participants further shows that 90% find Pro$^2$Assist useful, indicating its effectiveness for real-world procedural assistance.

AI.conclusion: Pro²Assist证明了基于多模态数据与步态感知推理的主动助手在长期程序性任务中的有效性，为AR眼镜驱动的智能协助提供了新范式。

title: Temporal Reasoning Is Not the Bottleneck: A Probabilistic Inconsistency Framework for Neuro-Symbolic QA
summary: Despite significant advances, large language models (LLMs) continue to exhibit brittle performance on complex temporal reasoning tasks. This failure mode is widely attributed to inherent deficits in autoregressive logical deduction. In this paper, we challenge this prevailing narrative, demonstrating that temporal reasoning is not the fundamental bottleneck; rather, the locus of failure lies in unstructured text-to-event representation. We introduce a novel neuro-symbolic question-answering framework governed by a Probabilistic Inconsistency Signal (PIS) that explicitly isolates perceptual errors from reasoning failures. By lifting unstructured text into explicit event graphs and interval constraints, our architecture strictly decouples semantic extraction from a symbolic reasoning engine. To robustly detect structural breaks, the PIS elegantly unifies symbolic credal intervals with epistemic neural uncertainty extracted via Evidential Deep Learning on LLM hidden states. Empirical evaluations reveal a striking paradigm shift: when provided with correct structural representations, our system's explicit proof traces achieve perfect 1.0 accuracy (4000/4000) and strictly zero false positives/negatives on temporal arithmetic benchmarks. On broader, noise-injected QA settings, the framework maintains a competitive 75.1\% accuracy while enabling deterministic, step-level failure localization. Ultimately, by isolating the representation bottleneck from the reasoning substrate, this work reframes temporal QA from an algorithmic reasoning challenge to a structural alignment problem, charting a verifiable path forward for reliable neuro-symbolic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示LLM在时序推理任务中的失败根源并非推理能力不足，而是非结构化文本到事件表示的转换瓶颈。作者提出基于概率不一致信号(PIS)的神经符号问答框架，通过将文本显式提升为事件图与区间约束，严格解耦语义提取与符号推理，在时序算术基准上达到完美准确率(1.0)，重新定义了时序QA问题本质。

AI.result: 在时序算术基准上达到完美1.0准确率(4000/4000)，零误报/漏报；在噪声注入QA场景下保持75.1%准确率，并支持确定性、步骤级故障定位。
AI.conclusion: 时序QA问题从算法推理挑战被重新定义为结构对齐问题，为可靠的神经符号AI提供了可验证的路径。

title: Parallel Prefix Verification for Speculative Generation
summary: We introduce PARSE (PArallel pRefix Speculative Engine), a speculative generation framework that accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by parallelizing prefix verification on a semantic level. Existing speculative decoding methods are fundamentally limited by token-level equivalence: the target model must verify each token, leading to short acceptance lengths and modest speedups. Moving to semantic or segment-level verification can substantially increase acceptance granularity, but prior approaches rely on sequential verification, introducing significant overhead and limiting practical gains. PARSE introduces parallel prefix verification, enabling semantic-level verification without sequential checks. Given a full draft from a draft model, the target model evaluates correctness across multiple prefixes in a single forward pass using a custom attention mask, directly identifying the maximal valid prefix. This eliminates sequential segment verification, and makes verification compute-efficient. PARSE is orthogonal to token-level speculative decoding and can be composed with it for additional gains. Across models and benchmarks, PARSE delivers $1.25\times$ to $4.3\times$ throughput gain over the target model, and $1.6\times$ to $4.5\times$ when composed with EAGLE-3, all with negligible accuracy degradation. This demonstrates parallel prefix verification as an effective, general approach to accelerating LLM inference.

AI.tldr: PARSE提出了一种并行前缀验证的推测生成框架，通过语义级别并行验证替代传统的逐令牌验证，显著加速LLM推理，与EAGLE-3组合可实现1.6倍至4.5倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码方法受限于令牌级等价验证，每个令牌都需要目标模型验证，导致接受长度短、加速效果有限。虽然后续有语义级或段级验证方法，但它们依赖顺序验证，引入了显著开销。
AI.method: PARSE引入并行前缀验证机制：从草稿模型获取完整草稿后，目标模型通过自定义注意力掩码在一次前向传播中同时评估多个前缀的正确性，直接识别最大有效前缀，消除了顺序段验证。
AI.result: 在多种模型和基准测试中，PARSE相比目标模型实现了1.25倍至4.3倍的吞吐量增益；与EAGLE-3组合使用时达到1.6倍至4.5倍增益，且准确性下降可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 并行前缀验证是一种有效且通用的LLM推理加速方法，与现有令牌级推测解码正交，可组合使用以获得额外收益。
idea_en: Parallel prefix verification for semantic-level speculative decoding: a method that uses a custom attention mask to evaluate correctness across multiple prefixes in a single forward pass, eliminating sequential segment verification
Custom attention mask mechanism for simultaneous verification of multiple candidate prefixes against a target LLM in one forward pass
Composable speculative framework that combines semantic-level parallel prefix verification with token-level speculative decoding (e.g., EAGLE-3) for multiplicative inference speedup
idea_ch: 并行前缀验证的语义级推测解码方法：通过自定义注意力掩码，在一次前向传播中同时评估多个前缀的正确性，消除了顺序段验证的开销
自定义注意力掩码机制：支持目标LLM在一次前向传播中同时验证多个候选前缀，直接识别最大有效前缀
可组合推测框架：将语义级并行前缀验证与令牌级推测解码（如EAGLE-3）正交组合，实现推理加速的乘法增益

title: Agent Island: A Saturation- and Contamination-Resistant Benchmark from Multiagent Games
summary: Static capabilities benchmarks suffer from saturation and contamination, making it difficult to track capabilities progress over time. We introduce Agent Island, a multiplayer simulation environment in which language-model agents compete in a game of interagent cooperation, conflict, and persuasion. The environment yields a dynamic benchmark designed to mitigate both saturation and contamination; new models can always outperform the current leading player in this winner-take-all game, and agents compete against other adaptive agents rather than face a fixed task set. We rank players with a Bayesian Plackett-Luce model, allowing us to quantify uncertainty in player skill. In 999 games involving 49 unique models, openai/gpt-5.5 dominates its peers with a posterior mean skill of 5.64, compared with 3.10 for the second-ranked model, openai/gpt-5.2, and 2.86 for the third-ranked model, openai/gpt-5.3-codex. We release the game logs as a dataset for analyses of model behavior. As an example, we investigate same-provider preference in final-round votes and find that models are 8.3 p.p. more likely to support a same-provider finalist than finalists from other providers. This preference is not uniform across providers: among separately estimated providers, the effect is strongest for OpenAI models and weakest for Anthropic models.

AI.tldr: 提出Agent Island多智能体仿真环境，通过语言模型代理在合作、冲突与说服游戏中的动态竞争来缓解静态基准的饱和与污染问题，并利用贝叶斯Plackett-Luce模型进行技能排名。
AI.motivation: 现有静态能力基准存在饱和与污染问题，难以持续追踪模型能力进步，需要一种动态、抗污染的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建多智能体仿真环境Agent Island，让语言模型代理在合作/冲突/说服游戏中竞争；采用赢家通吃机制确保新模型总能超越当前领先者；使用贝叶斯Plackett-Luce模型量化技能不确定性并排名。
AI.result: 在49个独特模型参与的999场游戏中，openai/gpt-5.5以5.64的后验技能均值领先，第二名为openai/gpt-5.2（3.10），第三名为openai/gpt-5.3-codex（2.86）。发现模型在最终投票中对同供应商最终支持者存在8.3%的偏好，其中OpenAI模型效应最强，Anthropic最弱。
AI.conclusion: Agent Island提供了一种动态、抗饱和抗污染的模型评估框架，并能揭示模型行为特征如同供应商偏好，为模型行为分析提供了新的数据集和方法论。
idea_en: A multiplayer agent competition environment (Agent Island) where language models compete in games of cooperation, conflict and persuasion, serving as a dynamic benchmark that resists saturation and contamination through a winner-take-all mechanism.
A Bayesian Plackett-Luce ranking method for quantifying uncertainty in language model agent skill levels based on competitive game outcomes.
A same-provider preference detection method that analyzes inter-agent voting behavior to reveal provider-specific biases in language model decision-making.
idea_ch: 一种多智能体竞争环境（Agent Island），让语言模型在合作、冲突与说服游戏中竞争，通过赢家通吃机制提供动态基准，有效抵抗基准饱和与数据污染。
基于贝叶斯Plackett-Luce模型的技能排名方法，通过竞争游戏结果量化语言模型代理技能水平的不确定性。
一种同供应商偏好检测方法，通过分析代理间投票行为揭示语言模型决策中特定供应商的偏见效应。

title: The Scaling Properties of Implicit Deductive Reasoning in Transformers
summary: We investigate the scaling properties of implicit deductive reasoning over Horn clauses in depth-bounded Transformers. By systematically decorrelating provability from spurious features and enforcing algorithmic alignment, we find that in sufficiently deep models with a bidirectional prefix mask, implicit reasoning approaches explicit CoT performance across graph topologies and problem widths, though CoT remains necessary for depth extrapolation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了深度有界Transformer在隐式演绎推理（Horn子句）中的缩放性质。通过解耦证明与虚假特征、强制算法对齐，发现足够深的双向前缀掩码模型在隐式推理上接近显式思维链性能，但深度外推仍需思维链。
AI.motivation: 探索深度有界Transformer在隐式演绎推理中的缩放能力，以及隐式推理与显式思维链推理在多大程度上可以匹配。
AI.method: 系统性地解耦证明与虚假特征的相关性，强制算法对齐，使用双向前缀掩码的深度模型进行实验。
AI.result: 足够深的双向前缀掩码模型中，隐式推理在图拓扑和问题宽度上接近显式思维链性能；但深度外推仍需思维链。
AI.conclusion: 隐式推理在深度足够时可接近显式思维链效果，但思维链在深度外推场景中仍不可替代。
idea_en: A method for improving implicit deductive reasoning in Transformers by decorrelating provability from spurious features and enforcing algorithmic alignment.
A bidirectional prefix mask mechanism for depth-bounded Transformers that enables implicit reasoning to approach explicit Chain-of-Thought performance.
A systematic decorrelation technique to remove spurious feature correlations in Horn clause reasoning tasks.
An algorithmic alignment enforcement method that allows Transformers to scale implicit reasoning capabilities across graph topologies and problem widths.
A hybrid reasoning architecture combining implicit reasoning with explicit Chain-of-Thought for depth extrapolation tasks where implicit reasoning alone fails.
idea_ch: 一种通过解耦证明与虚假特征、强制算法对齐来改进Transformer隐式演绎推理的方法。
一种用于深度有界Transformer的双向前缀掩码机制，使隐式推理接近显式思维链性能。
一种系统性解耦技术，消除Horn子句推理任务中的虚假特征相关性。
一种算法对齐强制方法，使Transformer的隐式推理能力在图拓扑和问题宽度上实现缩放。
一种混合推理架构，结合隐式推理与显式思维链，用于隐式推理失败的深度外推任务。

title: When Context Hurts: The Crossover Effect of Knowledge Transfer on Multi-Agent Design Exploration
comment: 16 pages, 14 tables. 2,700 multi-agent experiments across 10 software design tasks, 7 artifact conditions, and 4 convergence pressure levels
summary: The prevailing assumption in agent orchestration is that more context is better. We test this on multi-agent software design across 10 tasks, 7 context-injection conditions, and over 2,700 runs, and find a crossover effect: the same artifact type improves design exploration on some tasks (up to 20$\times$ tradeoff coverage) and actively degrades it on others (up to 46% reduction). On several tasks, an irrelevant document performs as well as or better than every relevant artifact. The direction is predicted by a single measurable variable--baseline exploration without context--with Pearson $r = -0.82$ ($p < 0.001$). Probing the mechanism by manipulating convergence pressure through prompt design reveals two distinct regimes: convergence driven by training data priors (natural) responds to artifact disruption, while convergence driven by explicit instructions (induced) does not. The implication is that context injection should be conditional, not universal: one no-context trial is a cheap diagnostic that predicts whether knowledge artifacts will help or hurt a given task.

AI.tldr: 研究发现多智能体协同中注入上下文信息并非总是有益，存在交叉效应：同一类文档在某些任务上可提升20倍探索效果，在另一些任务上却降低46%性能。通过一次无上下文的基线测试即可预测上下文注入是有益还是有害（Pearson r = -0.82）。
AI.motivation: 挑战"越多上下文越好"的主流假设，验证上下文注入在不同软件设计任务中的实际效果差异。
AI.method: 在10个任务、7种上下文注入条件、2700多次运行中测试多智能体软件设计，通过基线探索度预测上下文效果，并通过操纵收敛压力探究机制。
AI.result: 发现上下文注入存在交叉效应：某些任务提升20倍权衡覆盖，某些任务降低46%性能；无关文档有时效果等同或优于相关文档；基线探索度可预测方向（r=-0.82）。
AI.conclusion: 上下文注入应有条件而非普遍适用，一次无上下文的低成本试运行即可作为诊断手段。
idea_en: A method for adaptive context injection in multi-agent systems, where a single no-context trial run is used as a diagnostic to predict whether adding knowledge artifacts will improve or degrade task performance.

A mechanism for detecting the convergence regime of an AI system (natural vs. induced convergence) by manipulating convergence pressure through prompt design, enabling tailored context injection strategies.

A technique for measuring baseline exploration level without context as a predictor variable (Pearson r = -0.82) to determine whether context injection will have positive or negative effects on multi-agent software design tasks.

A conditional context injection framework that dynamically determines whether to inject knowledge artifacts based on task characteristics, avoiding the universal context assumption that can degrade performance by up to 46%.
idea_ch: 一种自适应上下文注入方法：通过一次无上下文的试运行作为诊断手段，预测注入知识文档是否会提升或降低多智能体系统在特定任务上的性能
一种基于收敛机制检测的上下文注入策略：通过提示设计操纵收敛压力，区分自然收敛（受训练数据先验驱动）和诱导收敛（受显式指令驱动），从而定制上下文注入方案
一种基线探索度测量技术：在没有上下文的情况下测量智能体的探索水平，作为预测上下文注入效果的指标（Pearson相关系数r=-0.82），准确判断注入上下文对多智能体软件设计任务的影响方向
一种条件式上下文注入框架：根据任务特征动态决定是否注入知识文档，避免普遍注入导致性能下降高达46%的问题

title: Deployment-Relevant Alignment Cannot Be Inferred from Model-Level Evaluation Alone
summary: Alignment evaluation in machine learning has largely become evaluation of models. Influential benchmarks score model outputs under fixed inputs, such as truthfulness, instruction following, or pairwise preference, and these scores are often used to support claims about deployed alignment. This paper argues that deployment-relevant alignment cannot be inferred from model-level evaluation alone. Alignment claims should instead be indexed to the level at which evidence is collected: model-level, response-level, interaction-level, or deployment-level. Two studies support this position. First, a structured audit of eleven alignment benchmarks, extended to a sixteen-benchmark corpus, dual-coded against an eight-dimension rubric with Cohen's kappa = 0.87, finds that user-facing verification support is absent across every benchmark examined, while process steerability is nearly absent. The few interactional benchmarks identified, including tau-bench, CURATe, Rifts, and Common Ground, remain fragmented in coverage, and benchmark construction rather than data source determines what is measured. Second, a blinded cross-model stress test using 180 transcripts across three frontier models and four scaffolds finds that the same verification scaffold raises one model's verification support to ceiling while leaving another categorically unchanged. This shows that scaffold efficacy is model-dependent and that the gap identified by the audit cannot be closed at the model level alone. We propose a system-level evaluation agenda: alignment profiles instead of single scores, fixed-scaffolding protocols for comparable interactional evaluation, and reporting templates that make the inferential distance between evaluation evidence and deployment claims explicit.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了机器学习中的对齐评估不能仅停留在模型层面，而应区分模型级、响应级、交互级和部署级四个层次。通过审计16个对齐基准和跨模型压力测试，发现现有基准缺乏用户验证支持和过程可操控性，且支架有效性具有模型依赖性。提出系统级评估议程，包括对齐档案、固定支架协议和报告模板。
AI.motivation: 当前对齐评估主要局限于模型级评估（如对固定输入的评分），但这些评分不足以支撑部署相关的对齐声明。本文旨在论证部署相关的对齐无法仅从模型级评估推断，需要更细粒度的评估层次框架。
AI.method: 1) 对11个对齐基准进行结构化审计，后扩展至16个基准，使用八维度评估框架进行双编码（Cohen's kappa=0.87）。2) 盲法跨模型压力测试：使用180个转录文本，跨越3个前沿模型和4种支架，测试相同验证支架在不同模型上的效果差异。
AI.result: 1) 所有被审查基准均缺乏用户端验证支持，过程可操控性几乎不存在。2) 少数交互基准（tau-bench、CURATe、Rifts、Common Ground）覆盖碎片化，基准构建方式而非数据源决定测量内容。3) 相同验证支架使一个模型的验证支持达到天花板，而对另一个模型无实质改变，说明支架效果具有模型依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 部署相关的对齐不能仅靠模型级评估推断，应建立系统级评估议程：采用对齐档案替代单一评分、制定固定支架协议以便进行可比较的交互评估、设计报告模板明确评估证据与部署声明之间的推理距离。
idea_en: A multi-level alignment evaluation framework (model-level, response-level, interaction-level, deployment-level) that indexes alignment claims to the specific level at which evidence is collected, enabling more precise and deployment-relevant assessment.

A system-level alignment profile methodology that replaces single-score benchmarks with multi-dimensional profiles covering verification support, process steerability, and other interaction-level capabilities.
A fixed-scaffolding protocol for comparable interaction-level alignment evaluation across different models, enabling standardized assessment of model-scaffold combinations.
A reporting template format that explicitly quantifies and communicates the inferential distance between evaluation evidence and deployment claims, making limitations of alignment claims transparent.
idea_ch: 一种多层次对齐评估框架（模型级、响应级、交互级、部署级），将对齐声明索引到证据收集的具体层次，实现更精确且与部署相关的评估。
一种系统级对齐档案方法，用涵盖验证支持、过程可操控性等交互能力的多维档案替代单一评分基准。
一种固定支架协议，用于不同模型之间可比较的交互级对齐评估，实现模型-支架组合的标准化评估。
一种报告模板格式，显式量化并传达评估证据与部署声明之间的推理距离，使对齐声明的局限性透明化。

title: How Does Thinking Mode Change LLM Moral Judgments? A Controlled Instant-vs-Thinking Comparison Across Five Frontier Models
summary: We evaluate whether enabling provider-exposed reasoning mode changes moral judgments within the same model checkpoint. Across 100 moral-judgment scenarios and five frontier reasoning-trained LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT 5.5, Gemini 3 Flash, DeepSeek V3.1, and Qwen3.5 397B), aggregate binary-verdict agreement remains high and statistically indistinguishable between instant and thinking modes (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.78 vs. 0.79). However, disagreement is concentrated in 21 model-disputed scenarios, where instant-mode agreement is near chance (alpha = 0.08). On these scenarios, reasoning directionally narrows cross-model disagreement, increasing mean pairwise agreement from 5.4 to 6.7 out of 10. Reasoning also reduces demographic-judgment inconsistency in three of five models and does not increase it for any model. Across all five model families, reasoning changes self-labeled ethical frameworks more often than binary verdicts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了推理模式（thinking mode）是否会影响大语言模型在道德判断上的一致性。在100个道德场景和5个前沿推理模型中，发现推理模式与即时模式在整体判断上高度一致，但在争议场景中推理方向性减少了模型间分歧，并降低了一些模型的判断不一致性。
AI.motivation: 探究启用推理模式是否以及如何改变语言模型在同一检查点下的道德判断，特别是判断一致性、模型间分歧程度和人口统计偏见方面。
AI.method: 使用100个道德判断场景，比较5个推理训练的LLM在即时模式和思考模式下的二元判断结果，采用Krippendorff's alpha衡量一致性，并分析模型间分歧和人口统计不一致性。
AI.result: 即答与思考模式聚合一致性高（alpha=0.78 vs 0.79）；21个争议场景中即时模式一致性接近随机（alpha=0.08），推理模式将平均配对一致性从5.4提升到6.7；推理减少了3/5模型的人口统计判断不一致性；推理模式比二元判决更频繁地改变模型自称的伦理框架。
AI.conclusion: 推理模式在整体上不显著改变道德判断，但在模型间存在分歧的场景中能减少分歧，且不会加剧人口统计偏见，但会更多地影响模型自我标注的伦理框架而非具体判决。
idea_en: Method and system for evaluating moral judgment consistency in large language models by comparing instant and reasoning modes across multiple moral scenarios.
Technique for reducing cross-model disagreement in ethical decision-making by enabling reasoning mode, achieving higher pairwise agreement scores.
System for detecting and mitigating demographic bias in LLM moral judgments through controlled reasoning-mode activation.
Method for quantifying ethical framework shifts in LLMs by comparing self-labeled ethical labels before and after reasoning mode activation.
idea_ch: 一种通过比较即时模式和推理模式下多个道德场景的二元判断来评估大语言模型道德判断一致性的方法及系统。
一种通过启用推理模式来减少模型间在伦理决策上分歧的技术，实现更高的模型间配对一致性评分。
一种通过控制推理模式激活来检测和减轻大语言模型道德判断中人口统计偏见的方法。
一种通过比较推理模式激活前后模型自我标注的伦理框架变化来量化LLM伦理框架偏移的方法。

title: From Parameter Dynamics to Risk Scoring : Quantifying Sample-Level Safety Degradation in LLM Fine-tuning
summary: Safety alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is extremely fragile, as fine-tuning on a small number of benign samples can erase safety behaviors learned from millions of preference examples. Existing studies attempt to explain this phenomenon by comparing parameters and hidden states before and after fine-tuning, but overlook their dynamic evolution during fine-tuning. In this paper, we uncover a critical mechanism underlying safety degradation by analyzing parameter dynamics, where benign fine-tuning causes parameters to cumulatively drift toward danger-aligned directions, progressively undermining the model's safety. This finding suggests that samples contributing more to this drift has greater fine-tuning risks. Based on this insight, we propose a method of Sample-Level Quantification of Safety Degradation (SQSD), which quantifies the influence of each training sample on safety degradation. Specifically, SQSD computes continuous risk scores to samples by measuring their induced parameter updates' projection difference between danger and safety directions. Extensive experiments across multiple models and datasets demonstrate that SQSD effectively quantifies sample-level fine-tuning risks and exhibits strong transferability across model architectures, parameter scales, and parameter-efficient methods.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析参数动态演化，发现良性微调会导致LLM参数向危险对齐方向累积漂移，从而破坏安全对齐，并提出SQSD方法量化每个样本对安全退化的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅比较微调前后的参数和隐藏状态，忽视了微调过程中参数的动态演化过程，导致对安全退化机制的理解不足。
AI.method: 提出SQSD方法，通过测量每个训练样本诱导的参数更新在安全方向与危险方向之间的投影差异，计算连续的风险分数，从而量化样本级微调风险。
AI.result: 在多个模型和数据集上的实验表明，SQSD能有效量化样本级微调风险，并展现出跨模型架构、参数尺度和参数高效方法的强迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 良性微调导致参数向危险方向累积漂移是安全退化的关键机制，SQSD方法可有效识别高风险样本，为安全微调提供指导。
idea_en: A method for quantifying sample-level safety degradation risk during LLM fine-tuning by measuring the projection difference of parameter updates between safety and danger directions.
A parameter dynamics analysis framework that tracks cumulative drift toward danger-aligned directions during benign fine-tuning.
A continuous risk scoring system for training samples based on the directional divergence of their induced parameter updates from safety alignment.
A transferable risk quantification technique that works across different LLM architectures, parameter scales, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods.
idea_ch: 一种通过测量参数更新在安全方向与危险方向之间的投影差异来量化LLM微调过程中样本级安全退化风险的方法
一种参数动态分析框架，可追踪良性微调过程中参数向危险对齐方向的累积漂移
一种基于训练样本诱导参数更新偏离安全对齐方向的连续风险评分系统
一种跨不同LLM架构、参数规模和参数高效微调方法均具有强迁移性的风险量化技术

title: SensingAgents: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Framework for Robust IMU Activity Recognition
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensors is a cornerstone of mobile health, smart environments, and human-computer interaction. However, current deep learning-based HAR models often struggle with heavy reliance on labeled data, position-specific ambiguity, and a lack of transparent reasoning. Inspired by the advanced agents framework, which emulates a collaborative agent using Large Language Models (LLMs), we propose SensingAgents, a novel multi-agent system for robust IMU activity recognition. SensingAgents organizes LLM-powered agents into specialized roles: a group of Analyst Agents for position-specific sensor analysis (arm, wrist, belt, pocket), a pair of Advocate Agents that resolves sensor conflicts through dynamic and static dialectical debates, and a Decision Agent that ensures reliability under sensor drift or failure. Evaluation on the Shoaib dataset demonstrates that SensingAgents significantly outperforms state-of-the-art single-agent and multi-agent LLM models, achieving an accuracy of 79.5% in a zero setting--29% higher than existing agent models and 9.4% higher than deep learning baselines--particularly in complex scenarios where multi-sensor data is conflicting or noisy. Our work highlights the potential of multi-agent collaborative reasoning for advancing the robustness and interpretability of ubiquitous sensing systems.

AI.tldr: 提出SensingAgents，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，通过角色分工（分析师、辩论者、决策者）实现鲁棒的IMU人体活动识别，在零样本设置下准确率达79.5%。
AI.motivation: 当前基于深度学习的HAR模型依赖大量标注数据，存在位置特异性模糊和缺乏可解释推理的问题。
AI.method: 构建多智能体系统：Analyst Agents负责各位置传感器分析，Advocate Agents通过动态/静态辩证辩论解决传感器冲突，Decision Agent确保在传感器漂移或故障下的可靠性。
AI.result: 在Shoaib数据集上，零样本准确率79.5%，比现有智能体模型高29%，比深度学习基线高9.4%。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协作推理能显著提升泛在感知系统的鲁棒性和可解释性。
idea_en: A multi-agent system for IMU-based HAR where LLM-powered agents are assigned specialized roles (analyst, advocate, decision) to collaboratively process sensor data.
A dynamic and static dialectical debate mechanism between Advocate Agents to resolve conflicting multi-sensor data in HAR.
A Decision Agent architecture that maintains recognition reliability under sensor drift or sensor failure conditions.
A role-differentiated analyst agent structure for position-specific sensor analysis (arm, wrist, belt, pocket) in wearable activity recognition.

倡导智能体之间的动态与静态辩证辩论机制，用于解决多传感器数据冲突问题。
决策智能体架构，在传感器漂移或故障条件下保持识别可靠性。

title: AuditRepairBench: A Paired-Execution Trace Corpus for Evaluator-Channel Ranking Instability in Agent Repair
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, NeurIPS 2026 Evaluation and D Directions Track
summary: Agent-repair leaderboards reorder under evaluator reconfiguration, and a measurable share of the reordering is produced by methods that consult evaluator-derived signal during internal selection of candidate repairs. We document this failure mode on a public leaderboard and release AuditRepairBench, a paired-execution trace corpus of 576,000 registered cells (96,000 executed) that operationalizes evaluator-channel-blocking ranking instability within a declared observability boundary. A modular screening architecture decides pathway-blocking through four interchangeable implementations, a learned influence proxy, a rule-based channel-exposure ratio that uses no trained model, a counterfactual sensitivity proxy, and a sparse human-audit proxy, combined into a screening posterior that feeds a cell-level flip functional, a set-valued label, a stratified system score, and a set-valued leaderboard. The resource is supported by mechanism-anchored validation on an 80-case source-level channel-surgery subset, an independent-discovery protocol under which two annotator groups separated from the pipeline developers discover coupling patterns blinded to the screening design and the frozen ensemble attains pooled AUROC 0.83 on their 79 cases, implementation robustness, uncertainty propagation that raises 95% coverage from 0.81 to 0.95, and forward transfer with pooled community-evaluator Spearman \r{ho} = 0.65. Screening-guided blinding patches reduce rank displacement by 55--74% (mean 62%) at fewer than 50 lines of code, whereas random channel blinding produces at most 7% reduction and generic retraining at most 13%. AuditRepairBench-Lite, a rule-only configuration on a 12,000-cell subset, preserves the leaderboard at Kendall τ = 0.88 under twenty-four GPU-hours and is the primary release artifact at 42 GB.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了一个漏洞：当评估器配置改变时，程序修复排行榜会发生重新排序，且部分重排源于方法在内部选择候选修复时使用了评估器信号。为此发布了AuditRepairBench数据集（含57.6万注册单元格）和一套模块化筛选架构，并验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有程序修复排行榜在评估器重新配置时会出现不可靠的排名波动，且部分方法通过作弊方式（在内部选择候选修复时利用评估器信号）导致排名失真，需要一套系统的方法来检测、量化和缓解这一问题。
AI.method: 提出模块化筛选架构，包含四种可互换的通道阻断实现：学习型影响代理、基于规则的通道暴露比（无需训练模型）、反事实敏感度代理、稀疏人工审计代理。这些模块组合成筛选后验概率，用于细胞级翻转函数、集合标签、分层系统分数和集合排行榜。通过机制锚定验证、独立发现协议等方法验证有效性。
AI.result: 筛选引导的掩蔽补丁可将排名位移降低55-74%（平均62%），仅需少于50行代码；而随机通道掩蔽最多减少7%，通用重训练最多减少13%。冻结集成在独立发现协议上达到池化AUROC 0.83，95%覆盖率从0.81提升至0.95，前向迁移Spearman ρ=0.65。
AI.conclusion: 评估器通道阻断是一种有效且轻量的方法，可用于提升程序修复排行榜的鲁棒性，发布的数据集和架构为未来研究提供了基础资源。
idea_en: A modular screening architecture for detecting evaluator-channel blocking in automated program repair leaderboards, comprising four interchangeable implementations: learned influence proxy, rule-based channel-exposure ratio, counterfactual sensitivity proxy, and sparse human-audit proxy.

A paired-execution trace corpus (AuditRepairBench) with 576,000 registered cells and 96,000 executed cells that operationalizes evaluator-channel-blocking ranking instability within a declared observability boundary.

A screening-guided blinding patch method that reduces rank displacement by 55-74% (mean 62%) with fewer than 50 lines of code, significantly outperforming random channel blinding (≤7%) and generic retraining (≤13%).
A cell-level flip functional and set-valued leaderboard mechanism that provides stratified system scores with uncertainty propagation, achieving 95% coverage improvement from 0.81 to 0.95.
An independent-discovery protocol where annotator groups blinded to screening design discover coupling patterns, enabling objective validation of the screening architecture.
AuditRepairBench-Lite: a rule-only configuration on a 12,000-cell subset preserving leaderboard at Kendall τ=0.88 under 24 GPU-hours, enabling lightweight deployment.

AuditRepairBench配对执行轨迹语料库，包含57.6万注册单元格和9.6万执行单元格，在声明的可观测边界内将评估器通道阻断的排名不稳定性操作化。

一种细胞级翻转函数和集合排行榜机制，提供带有不确定性传播的分层系统评分，将95%覆盖率从0.81提升至0.95。
一种独立发现协议，对筛选设计不知情的标注者组发现耦合模式，实现对筛选架构的客观验证。
AuditRepairBench-Lite：基于规则的轻量配置，在1.2万单元格子集上以24 GPU小时保持Kendall τ=0.88的排行榜一致性，支持轻量级部署。

title: Budget-aware Auto Optimizer Configurator
summary: Optimizer states occupy massive GPU memory in large-scale model training. However, gradients in different network blocks exhibit distinct behaviors, such as varying directional stability and scale anisotropy, implying that expensive optimizer states are not universally necessary and using a global optimizer is often memory-inefficient. We propose the Budget-Aware Optimizer Configurator (BAOC) to reduce memory cost by assigning suitable optimizer configurations to individual blocks under given budgets. Specifically, BAOC samples gradient streams to derive statistical metrics that quantify the potential performance risk of applying cheaper configurations (e.g., low precision or removing momentum). It then solves a constrained allocation problem to minimize total risk under memory and time budgets, selecting a budget-feasible configuration for each block. Experiments across vision, language, and diffusion workloads demonstrate that BAOC maintains training quality while significantly reducing the memory usage of optimizer states. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/BAOC-45C6.

AI.tldr: BAOC是一种预算感知的优化器配置器，通过分析不同网络块的梯度行为，在给定内存和时间预算下为每个块分配合适的优化器配置（如低精度、移除动量等），在保持训练质量的同时显著降低优化器状态的内存占用。
AI.motivation: 大规模模型训练中优化器状态占用大量GPU内存，而不同网络块的梯度行为存在差异（如方向稳定性、尺度各向异性），使用全局统一优化器内存效率低下，需要一种自适应的、预算感知的优化器配置方法。
AI.method: BAOC通过采样梯度流计算统计指标，量化使用低成本配置（低精度、移除动量等）的潜在性能风险，然后求解约束分配优化问题，在内存和时间预算下为每个块选择预算可行的最优配置，以最小化总风险。
AI.result: 在视觉、语言和扩散模型上的实验表明，BAOC能够显著降低优化器状态的内存使用量，同时保持训练质量。
AI.conclusion: 不同网络块的梯度行为存在差异，通过预算感知的个性化优化器配置可以在不牺牲训练质量的前提下大幅减少优化器状态的内存开销。
idea_en: A budget-aware optimizer configurator (BAOC) that assigns different optimizer configurations (e.g., precision levels, momentum usage) to individual network blocks based on their gradient behavior statistics, rather than using a uniform global optimizer.
A method for quantifying the performance risk of applying cheaper optimizer configurations (low precision, removing momentum) by sampling gradient streams and deriving statistical metrics.
A constrained optimization-based allocation mechanism that selects budget-feasible optimizer configurations for each block to minimize total performance risk under memory and time budget constraints.

A technique for memory-efficient large-scale model training that dynamically configures optimizer states per network block according to gradient directional stability and scale anisotropy characteristics.
idea_ch: 一种预算感知的优化器配置器(BAOC)，根据不同网络块的梯度行为统计特性，为每个块分配差异化的优化器配置（如精度等级、动量使用策略），替代传统的全局统一优化器方案。
一种通过采样梯度流并推导统计指标来量化低成本优化器配置（低精度、移除动量等）性能风险的方法。
一种基于约束优化的分配机制，在内存和时间预算约束下为每个网络块选择预算可行的优化器配置，以最小化总体性能风险。
一种根据梯度方向稳定性和尺度各向异性特征，为大规模模型训练逐网络块动态配置优化器状态的内存高效训练技术。

title: Reward-Decomposed Reinforcement Learning for Immersive Video Role-Playing
summary:
Text-based role-playing models can imitate character styles, yet they often fail to reflect a scene's atmosphere and evolving tension, both essential for immersive applications such as Virtual Reality (VR) games and interactive narratives. We study video-grounded role-playing dialogue and introduce EBM-RL (Eye-Brain-Mouth Reinforcement Learning), a decoupled GRPO-based framework that explicitly separates observation ([perception]), reasoning ([think]), and utterance ([answer]). This structure promotes human-like sensory grounding by compelling the model to first attend to visual cues, then form internal interpretations, and finally generate context-appropriate dialogue.
  EBM-RL integrates four complementary rewards: (i) CLIP-based scene-text alignment to improve ambiance and emotion; (ii) a Perceptual-Cognitive reward that encourages [perception] and [think] processes that increase the likelihood of the reference response; (iii) answer accuracy to ensure faithfulness; and (iv) a dense format reward to enforce the desired structured output.
  Extensive experiments demonstrate that EBM-RL substantially outperforms text-only role-playing baselines and larger-scale vision-language models on our immersive role-playing benchmark, delivering simultaneous gains in visual-atmosphere consistency and character authenticity. Beyond the role-playing domain, EBM-RL also exhibits strong zero-shot generalization: without any additional fine-tuning, it consistently improves performance on out-of-domain VideoQA benchmarks. We additionally release an open-source dataset for video-grounded role-playing dialogue.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EBM-RL（眼-脑-口强化学习）框架，通过解耦的GRPO方法将视频角色扮演对话明确分为感知、思考和回答三个阶段，并集成四种互补奖励机制，显著提升场景氛围一致性和角色真实性，同时在零样本视频问答任务中展现出强大泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有文本角色扮演模型虽能模仿角色风格，但无法反映场景氛围和动态张力，难以支撑VR游戏和互动叙事等沉浸式应用。
AI.method: 提出EBM-RL框架：基于GRPO的解耦结构，将对话生成拆分为[perception]（视觉感知）、[think]（内部推理）和[answer]（回答输出）三个阶段；集成四种奖励机制：CLIP场景-文本对齐奖励、感知-认知奖励、答案准确性奖励和格式奖励。
AI.result: 在沉浸式角色扮演基准测试中显著优于纯文本基线和更大规模的视觉语言模型；在零样本VideoQA任务上展现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EBM-RL通过显式分离感知、推理和表达阶段，实现了类人感官基础的角色扮演对话，并具备跨域迁移潜力。
idea_en: Decoupled GRPO-based reinforcement learning framework for video-grounded role-playing dialogue that explicitly separates perception, reasoning, and utterance generation into distinct stages.
CLIP-based scene-text alignment reward mechanism for improving ambiance and emotional consistency between visual input and dialogue output.
Perceptual-Cognitive reward that rewards intermediate perception and thinking processes that increase likelihood of reference response.
Multi-reward integration scheme combining scene-text alignment, perceptual-cognitive reward, answer accuracy, and format reward for structured output.
Structured output format with explicit tags [perception], [think], [answer] to enforce human-like sensory grounding in dialogue generation.
Zero-shot generalization capability of the EBM-RL framework to out-of-domain VideoQA benchmarks without additional fine-tuning.
idea_ch: 基于解耦GRPO的视频角色扮演对话强化学习框架，将感知、推理和回答生成显式分离为独立阶段
基于CLIP的场景-文本对齐奖励机制，用于提升视觉输入与对话输出之间的氛围和情感一致性
感知-认知奖励机制，对增加参考响应可能性的中间感知和思考过程进行奖励
多奖励集成方案：结合场景文本对齐奖励、感知认知奖励、答案准确性奖励和格式奖励
带有显式标签[perception]、[think]、[answer]的结构化输出格式，强制实现类人感官基础对话生成

title: AgentTrust: Runtime Safety Evaluation and Interception for AI Agent Tool Use
summary:
Modern AI agents execute real-world side effects through tool calls such as file operations, shell commands, HTTP requests, and database queries. A single unsafe action, including accidental deletion, credential exposure, or data exfiltration, can cause irreversible harm. Existing defenses are incomplete: post-hoc benchmarks measure behavior after execution, static guardrails miss obfuscation and multi-step context, and infrastructure sandboxes constrain where code runs without understanding what an action means.
  We present AgentTrust, a runtime safety layer that intercepts agent tool calls before execution and returns a structured verdict: allow, warn, block, or review. AgentTrust combines a shell deobfuscation normalizer, SafeFix suggestions for safer alternatives, RiskChain detection for multi-step attack chains, and a cache-aware LLM-as-Judge for ambiguous inputs.
  We release a 300-scenario benchmark across six risk categories and an additional 630 independently constructed real-world adversarial scenarios. On the internal benchmark, the production-only ruleset achieves 95.0% verdict accuracy and 73.7% risk-level accuracy at low-millisecond end-to-end latency. On the 630-scenario benchmark, evaluated under a patched ruleset and not claimed as zero-shot, AgentTrust achieves 96.7% verdict accuracy, including about 93% on shell-obfuscated payloads. AgentTrust is released under the AGPL-3.0 license and provides a Model Context Protocol server for MCP-compatible agents.

AI.tldr: AgentTrust是一个运行时安全层，在AI代理执行工具调用前进行拦截，通过shell去混淆、安全修复建议、多步攻击链检测和LLM辅助判断，返回允许、警告、阻止或审查等结构化裁决，实现高精度低延迟的安全防护。
AI.motivation: AI代理执行文件操作、shell命令、HTTP请求等工具调用时可能产生意外删除、凭证泄露等不可逆危害，而现有事后基准测试、静态防护和沙箱方案均存在不足，无法在运行时有效理解并阻止恶意操作。
AI.method: AgentTrust包含四个核心组件：(1) Shell去混淆归一化器，还原混淆命令；(2) SafeFix安全替代建议模块；(3) RiskChain多步攻击链检测；(4) 缓存感知的LLM-as-Judge用于模糊输入裁决。系统在工具调用前拦截并输出结构化裁决结果。
AI.result: 在300场景内部基准上，生产规则集达到95.0%裁决准确率和73.7%风险级别准确率，端到端延迟在毫秒级。在630场景基准上（使用补丁规则集），达到96.7%裁决准确率，对shell混淆负载约为93%。
AI.conclusion: AgentTrust通过多层运行时防护机制有效弥补了现有安全方案的空白，在准确性和延迟之间取得了良好平衡，并提供了MCP协议支持，具有良好的实用性和可扩展性。
idea_en: A runtime safety layer that intercepts AI agent tool calls before execution and returns a structured verdict (allow, warn, block, review).
A shell deobfuscation normalizer that transforms obfuscated shell commands into plain, analyzable forms before safety evaluation.
SafeFix module that generates safer alternative suggestions for potentially dangerous tool calls.
RiskChain detection mechanism for identifying multi-step attack chains across sequential agent tool calls.
A cache-aware LLM-as-Judge system that leverages cached reasoning to reduce latency for ambiguous or borderline inputs.
A structured verdict output format that provides both binary allow/block decisions and graded risk-level feedback (warn, review).
Combination of multiple defense layers (deobfuscation + safe alternatives + chain detection + LLM judgment) into a unified pre-execution safety framework for AI agents.
Integration of safety layer with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for compatibility with MCP-compatible agents.
idea_ch: 一种在AI代理工具调用执行前进行拦截并返回结构化裁决（允许、警告、阻止、审查）的运行时安全层方法

title: DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap): A Controllable and Interactive Red-Teaming Platform for AI Agents
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed across diverse domains to automate complex workflows through long-horizon and high-stakes action executions. Due to their high capability and flexibility, such agents raise significant security and safety concerns. A growing number of real-world incidents have shown that adversaries can easily manipulate agents into performing harmful actions, such as leaking API keys, deleting user data, or initiating unauthorized transactions. Evaluating agent security is inherently challenging, as agents operate in dynamic, untrusted environments involving external tools, heterogeneous data sources, and frequent user interactions. However, realistic, controllable, and reproducible environments for large-scale risk assessment remain largely underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce the DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap), the first controllable and interactive red-teaming platform for AI agents, spanning 14 real-world domains and over 50 simulation environments that replicate widely used systems such as Google Workspace, Paypal, and Slack. To scale the risk assessment of agents in DTap, we further propose DTap-Red, the first autonomous red-teaming agent that systematically explores diverse injection vectors (e.g., prompt, tool, skill, environment, combinations) and autonomously discovers effective attack strategies tailored to varying malicious goals. Using DTap-Red, we curate DTap-Bench, a large-scale red-teaming dataset comprising high-quality instances across domains, each paired with a verifiable judge to automatically validate attack outcomes. Through DTap, we conduct large-scale evaluations of popular AI agents built on various backbone models, spanning security policies, risk categories, and attack strategies, revealing systematic vulnerability patterns and providing valuable insights for developing secure next-generation agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap)——首个可控、可交互的AI Agent红队测试平台，覆盖14个真实世界领域和50余个模拟环境。同时提出DTap-Red自主红队测试Agent和DTap-Bench大规模数据集，用于系统性地评估和发现AI Agent的安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 随着AI Agent在自动化复杂工作流中广泛应用，其安全风险日益突出，但缺乏可用于大规模风险评估的、现实的、可控且可复现的测试环境。
AI.method: 1. 构建DTap平台：覆盖14个领域、50+模拟环境（如Google Workspace, PayPal, Slack）；2. 提出DTap-Red自主红队测试Agent，可探索多种攻击向量（提示、工具、技能、环境及其组合）；3. 构建DTap-Bench数据集，包含高质量红队测试实例和可验证的评判器。
AI.result: 通过对多种主流AI Agent和基础模型的大规模评估，揭示了系统性的漏洞模式，为开发安全的下一代Agent提供了重要见解。
AI.conclusion: DTap提供了首个可控、可交互的Agent安全评估平台，解决了大规模红队测试环境缺失的问题，DTap-Red实现了自动化攻击策略发现，对Agent安全性评估具有重要价值。
idea_en: A controllable and interactive red-teaming platform for AI agents that simulates real-world systems (Google Workspace, PayPal, Slack) across 14 domains and 50+ environments, enabling systematic security evaluation.

title: Strat-Reasoner: Reinforcing Strategic Reasoning of LLMs in Multi-Agent Games
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in certain reasoning tasks, they struggle in multi-agent games where the final outcome depends on the joint strategies of all agents. In multi-agent games, the non-stationarity of other agents brings significant challenges on the evaluation of the reasoning process and the credit assignment over multiple reasoning steps. Existing single-agent reinforcement learning (RL) approaches and their multi-agent extensions fail to address these challenges as they do not incorporate other agents in the reasoning process. In this work, we propose Strat-Reasoner, a novel RL-based framework that improves LLMs' strategic reasoning ability in multi-agent games. We introduce a novel recursive reasoning paradigm where an agent's reasoning also integrates other agents' reasoning processes. To provide effective reward signals for the intermediate reasoning sequences, we employ a centralized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) comparison module to evaluate the reasoning quality. Finally, we compute an accurate hybrid advantage and develop a group-relative RL approach to optimize the LLM policy. Experimental results show that Strat-Reasoner substantially improves strategic abilities of underlying LLMs, achieving 22.1\% average performance improvements across various multi-agent games.

AI.tldr: Strat-Reasoner是一个基于强化学习的框架，通过递归推理、集中式CoT比较模块和组相对强化学习，提升LLM在多智能体博弈中的战略推理能力，平均性能提升22.1%。
AI.motivation: LLM在多智能体博弈中表现不佳，因为其他智能体的非平稳性导致推理过程评估和信用分配困难，现有单智能体RL及其多智能体扩展未能将其他智能体纳入推理过程。

AI.result: 在多种多智能体博弈中，Strat-Reasoner显著提升底层LLM的战略能力，平均性能提升22.1%。

title: Curated AI beats frontier LLMs at pharma asset discovery
summary: General-purpose LLMs with web search are increasingly used to scout the competitive landscape of pharmaceutical pipelines. We benchmark Gosset -- an AI platform with a chat interface backed by curated target-, modality-, and indication-level drug-asset annotations -- against four frontier systems with web access (Claude Opus 4.7, GPT 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Perplexity sonar-pro) on ten niche oncology/immunology targets where most of the pipeline lives in the long tail of preclinical and Asian-developed assets. All five systems receive the same natural-language query and the same JSON output schema. Across 10 targets Gosset returns 3.2x more verified drugs per query than the best frontier system, at perfect precision and 100% recall against the cross-system union of verified drugs. The same curated index is exposed as a Gosset MCP server that any frontier model can call as a tool, suggesting that each of these systems can close most of the recall gap by swapping generic web search for a curated index behind the same chat interface.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了Gosset（一个基于AI的平台，拥有经过整理的目标、模态和适应症级别药物资产注释）与四个前沿系统（Claude Opus 4.7、GPT 5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Perplexity sonar-pro）在十个 niche 肿瘤学/免疫学靶点上的表现。Gosset 返回的已验证药物数量是最佳前沿系统的3.2倍，精确率完美，召回率100%。其整理索引可通过MCP服务器供任何前沿模型调用，缩小召回差距。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型结合网页搜索在药物管线竞争情报分析中存在不足，尤其是在长尾的临床前和亚洲开发的资产方面。作者旨在通过构建Gosset平台（基于整理的专业索引）来弥补通用搜索的召回率差距。

AI.result: Gosset在每个查询中返回的已验证药物数量是最佳前沿系统的3.2倍，达到完美精确率和100%召回率（以跨系统已验证药物并集为基准）。通过MCP服务器方式，前沿系统可以缩小大部分召回差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过在通用对话界面背后使用专业整理索引而非通用网页搜索，可以显著提升药物管线情报检索的召回率和精确率，这提示了在特定领域用高质量结构化数据增强大语言模型的有效性。

A method for benchmarking AI systems on niche oncology/immunology targets by using a cross-system union of verified drugs as ground truth, enabling recall measurement.

title: A Foundation Model for Zero-Shot Logical Rule Induction
comment: Camera-ready version accepted at IJCAI 2026, with full appendices
summary: Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) learns interpretable logical rules from data. Existing methods are transductive: their learned parameters are bound to specific predicates and require retraining for each new task. We introduce Neural Rule Inducer (NRI), a pretrained model for zero-shot rule induction. Rather than encoding literal identities, NRI represents literals using domain-agnostic statistical properties such as class-conditional rates, entropy, and co-occurrence, which generalize across variable identities and counts without retraining. The model consists of a statistical encoder and a parallel slot-based decoder. Parallel decoding preserves the permutation invariance of logical disjunction; an autoregressive decoder would instead impose an arbitrary clause order. Product T-norm relaxation makes rule execution differentiable, allowing end-to-end training on prediction accuracy alone. We evaluate NRI on rule recovery, robustness to label noise and spurious correlations, and zero-shot transfer to real-world benchmarks, and we believe this work opens up the possibility of foundation models for symbolic reasoning. Code and the reference checkpoint are available at https://github.com/phuayj/neural-rule-inducer.

AI.tldr: 提出Neural Rule Inducer (NRI)，一种用于零样本规则归纳的预训练模型，通过统计编码和并行槽解码实现跨谓词的逻辑规则学习。
AI.motivation: 现有归纳逻辑编程(ILP)方法是直推式的，学到的参数绑定到特定谓词，每遇到新任务都需要重新训练，缺乏泛化能力。
AI.method: 1) 统计编码器：用领域无关的统计属性（如类条件概率、熵、共现频率）表示文字，而非文字标识；2) 并行槽解码器：保持逻辑析取的置换不变性，避免自回归解码带来的顺序约束；3) 乘积T范数松弛：使规则执行可微分，实现端到端训练。
AI.result: 在规则恢复、标签噪声和虚假相关性鲁棒性、以及零样本迁移到真实世界基准任务上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: NRI打开了符号推理基础模型的可能性，实现了无需重新训练的零样本规则归纳。
idea_en: Method of representing literals using domain-agnostic statistical properties (e.g., class-conditional rates, entropy, co-occurrence) instead of literal identities to enable zero-shot rule induction across different predicates
Parallel slot-based decoder architecture that preserves permutation invariance of logical disjunction for rule induction
Product T-norm relaxation technique for making logical rule execution differentiable and enabling end-to-end training on prediction accuracy alone
Pretrained neural model for zero-shot inductive logic programming that transfers across tasks without retraining

title: On-line Learning in Tree MDPs by Treating Policies as Bandit Arms
comment: Accepted as a full paper in the Main Track of AAMAS 2026
summary: A Tree Markov Decision Problem (T-MDP) is a finite-horizon MDP with a starting state $s_{1}$, in which every state is reachable from $s_{1}$ through exactly one state-action trajectory. T-MDPs arise naturally as abstractions of decision making in sequential games with perfect recall, against stationary opponents. We consider the problem of on-line learning in T-MDPs, both in the PAC and the regret-minimisation regimes. We show that well-known bandit algorithms -- \textsc{Lucb} and \textsc{Ucb} -- can be applied on T-MDPs by treating each policy as an arm. The apparent technical challenge in this approach is that the number of policies is exponential in the number of states. Our main innovation is in the design of confidence bounds based on data shared by the policies, so that the bandit algorithms can yet be implemented with polynomial memory and per-step computation. We obtain instance-dependent upper bounds on sample complexity and regret that sum a ``gap term'' from every terminal state, rather than every policy. Empirically, our algorithms consistently outperform available alternatives on a suite of hidden-information games.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在树形马尔可夫决策过程（T-MDP）中，通过将每个策略视为一个臂，利用策略间共享数据的置信区间设计，使经典赌博机算法（LUCB和UCB）能够以多项式内存和每步计算量实现在线学习，并获得与终端状态数量相关的样本复杂度和遗憾上界。
AI.motivation: T-MDP广泛存在于具有完美回忆的序贯博弈中，但现有方法面临策略数量指数级增长的挑战，需要高效在线学习算法。
AI.method: 将T-MDP中的每个策略视为赌博机算法的一个臂；设计基于策略间共享数据的置信区间，使得LUCB和UCB算法能以多项式复杂度实现；利用T-MDP的树形结构特性进行高效计算。
AI.result: 获得了与终端状态数量（而非策略数量）相关的样本复杂度和遗憾上界；实验表明算法在隐藏信息博弈中持续优于现有替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 证明了通过巧妙的置信区间设计，可以将指数级策略空间的T-MDP在线学习问题转化为多项式可解的赌博机问题，为序贯博弈中的决策学习提供了高效方法。
idea_en: A method for online learning in Tree Markov Decision Processes (T-MDPs) by treating each policy as an arm in bandit algorithms, enabling polynomial memory and per-step computation through confidence bounds based on data shared across policies.
A confidence interval design for bandit algorithms in T-MDPs that leverages shared data among policies, reducing the effective complexity from exponential in states to polynomial.
An instance-dependent upper bound on sample complexity and regret for T-MDPs expressed in terms of terminal states rather than policies, providing tighter theoretical guarantees.
A method to apply LUCB (Lower Upper Confidence Bound) algorithm to T-MDPs with polynomial computational cost by exploiting the tree structure of state transitions.
A method to apply UCB (Upper Confidence Bound) algorithm to T-MDPs with polynomial memory requirements by using shared statistical data across policies.
idea_ch: 一种将树形马尔可夫决策过程（T-MDP）中的每个策略视为赌博机算法臂的在线学习方法，通过基于策略间共享数据的置信区间设计，实现多项式内存和每步计算量。
一种针对T-MDP中赌博机算法的置信区间设计方法，利用策略间的共享数据，将有效复杂度从状态数的指数级降低为多项式级。
一种T-MDP样本复杂度和遗憾的实例依赖上界方法，该上界用终端状态数量而非策略数量表示，提供更紧的理论保证。
一种将LUCB（Lower Upper Confidence Bound）算法应用于T-MDP并具有多项式计算代价的方法，通过利用状态转移的树形结构特性实现。

title: Uno-Orchestra: Parsimonious Agent Routing via Selective Delegation
summary: Large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems typically rely on rigid orchestration, committing either to flat per-query routing or to hand-engineered task decomposition, so decomposition depth, worker choice, and inference budget are not jointly optimized under one objective. We introduce Uno-Orchestra, a unified orchestration policy that selectively decomposes a task and dispatches each subtask to an admissible (model, primitive) pair, with both decisions learned together from curated RL trajectories grounded in real worker interactions. Against 22 baselines on a 13-benchmark suite spanning math, code, knowledge, long-context, and agentic tool-use, Uno-Orchestra reaches 77.0% macro pass@1, roughly 16% above the strongest workflow baseline, at roughly an order of magnitude lower per-query cost, advancing the accuracy-efficiency frontier of selective delegation.

AI.tldr: 提出Uno-Orchestra统一编排策略，通过强化学习联合优化任务分解、worker选择和推理预算，在13个基准测试上以低一个数量级的成本达到77%的宏pass@1，优于22个基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统要么使用扁平化的逐查询路由，要么使用手动设计的任务分解，未能将分解深度、worker选择和推理预算在一个统一目标下联合优化。
AI.method: 提出Uno-Orchestra统一编排策略：1) 选择性分解任务；2) 将每个子任务分派到可接受的(模型, 原语)组合；3) 通过基于真实worker交互的强化学习轨迹联合学习这两个决策。
AI.result: 在涵盖数学、代码、知识、长上下文和agent工具使用的13个基准测试中，与22个基线对比，Uno-Orchestra达到77.0%宏pass@1，比最强工作流基线高约16%，同时成本降低约一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Uno-Orchestra推进了选择性委托的准确率-效率前沿，实现了精度与成本的最佳平衡。
idea_en: Selective task decomposition policy jointly optimized with worker (model, primitive) dispatch via RL trajectories from real worker interactions
Unified orchestration that jointly optimizes decomposition depth, worker choice, and inference budget under a single objective
Admissible (model, primitive) pair dispatch mechanism for optimal subtask assignment
RL-based training framework using curated trajectories grounded in real multi-agent worker interactions

title: Position: Embodied AI Requires a Privacy-Utility Trade-off
summary: Embodied AI (EAI) systems are rapidly transitioning from simulations into real-world domestic and other sensitive environments. However, recent EAI solutions have largely demonstrated advancements within isolated stages such as instruction, perception, planning and interaction, without considering their coupled privacy implications in high-frequency deployments where privacy leakage is often irreversible. This position paper argues that optimizing these components independently creates a systemic privacy crisis when deployed in sensitive settings, thereby advancing the position that privacy in EAI is a life cycle-level architectural constraint rather than a stage-local feature. To address these challenges, we propose Secure Privacy Integration in Next-generation Embodied AI (SPINE), a unified privacy-aware framework that treats privacy as a dynamic control signal governing cross-stage coupling throughout the entire EAI life cycle. SPINE decomposes the EAI pipeline into various stages and establishes a multi-criterion privacy classification matrix to orchestrate contextual sensitivity across stage boundaries. We conduct preliminary simulation and real-world case studies to conceptually validate how privacy constraints propagate downstream to reshape system behavior, illustrating the insufficiency of fragmented privacy patches and motivating future research directions into secure yet functional embodied AI systems. We detail the SPINE framework and case studies at https://github.com/rminshen03/EAI_Privacy_Position.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将隐私作为贯穿具身AI（EAI）全生命周期的架构级约束，提出SPINE框架，通过多准则隐私分类矩阵实现跨阶段耦合的隐私控制，而非传统的分阶段独立优化。
AI.motivation: 现有EAI系统在指令、感知、规划、交互等阶段独立优化，忽略了高频部署中跨阶段耦合带来的隐私泄露风险，且隐私泄露往往是不可逆的。
AI.method: 提出SPINE框架，将EAI流水线分解为多个阶段，建立多准则隐私分类矩阵，将隐私作为动态控制信号，实现跨阶段耦合的全生命周期隐私管理。
AI.result: 通过仿真和真实案例研究，概念性验证了隐私约束如何向下游传播并重塑系统行为，证明了碎片化隐私补丁的不足。
AI.conclusion: 隐私应是EAI系统的生命周期级架构约束而非阶段局部特征，SPINE框架为未来安全且功能完整的EAI系统指明了研究方向。
idea_en: A unified privacy-aware framework (SPINE) that treats privacy as a dynamic control signal governing cross-stage coupling throughout the entire Embodied AI lifecycle.
A multi-criterion privacy classification matrix for orchestrating contextual sensitivity across stage boundaries in Embodied AI pipelines.
idea_ch: 一种将隐私作为动态控制信号的统一隐私感知框架（SPINE），用于管理具身AI全生命周期的跨阶段耦合。
一种多准则隐私分类矩阵，用于在具身AI流水线的各阶段边界间编排上下文敏感性。

title: Executable World Models for ARC-AGI-3 in the Era of Coding Agents
summary: We evaluate an initial coding-agent system for ARC-AGI-3 in which the agent maintains an executable Python world model, verifies it against previous observations, refactors it toward simpler abstractions as a practical proxy for an MDL-like simplicity bias, and plans through the model before acting. The system is intentionally direct: it uses a scripted controller, predefined world-model interfaces, verifier programs, and a plan executor, but no hand-coded game-specific logic. We report results on the 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games. Each recorded playthrough uses a fresh agent instance with no access to previous playthrough-specific files or conversation state. Most games have a single recorded playthrough; for a few games, we report multiple independent fresh-agent playthroughs to expose run-to-run variability. The agent fully solved 7 games, achieved a Relative Human Action Efficiency greater than 75%, on 6 games, and obtained a mean per-game RHAE of 32.58%. Because the system uses no game-specific code, it can serve as a game-general baseline for ARC-AGI-3. Performance on the private validation set remains to be tested. Overall, the results provide preliminary evidence that verifier-driven executable world models are a promising approach for ARC-AGI-3 agents.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了一个用于ARC-AGI-3的初始编码智能体系统，该系统维护可执行的Python世界模型，通过验证器验证观察结果，通过重构简化抽象以引入类似MDL的简单性偏差，并在行动前通过模型进行规划。系统在25个公开游戏上取得了7个完全解决、6个RHAE>75%、平均RHAE 32.58%的成绩，可作为游戏通用基线。
AI.motivation: 为ARC-AGI-3任务开发一个无需游戏特定代码的通用智能体系统，通过可执行世界模型、验证驱动和简单性偏差来实现类人抽象推理能力。
AI.method: 系统由脚本控制器、预定义世界模型接口、验证器程序和计划执行器组成。智能体维护一个可执行的Python世界模型，通过验证器对比历史观察结果进行验证，通过重构向更简单抽象方向演化（作为MDL简单性偏差的代理），并在执行动作前通过模型进行规划推理。
AI.result: 在25个公开ARC-AGI-3游戏中：完全解决7个游戏；6个游戏达到RHAE>75%；平均每游戏RHAE为32.58%。系统使用独立的智能体实例，无跨游戏文件或对话状态访问。
AI.conclusion: 验证器驱动的可执行世界模型是ARC-AGI-3智能体的一个很有前景的方法，该系统可作为游戏通用基线。私有验证集上的性能尚待测试。
idea_en: Verifier-driven executable world model system for ARC-AGI-3: an agent maintains a runnable Python world model, verifies it against past observations, and refactors toward simpler abstractions as a practical MDL-like simplicity bias, then plans through the model before taking actions.
Scripted controller with predefined world-model interfaces, verifier programs, and plan executor that requires no hand-coded game-specific logic, serving as a game-general baseline.
Fresh agent instantiation per playthrough with zero cross-game file or conversation state access, enabling independent evaluation with run-to-run variability measurement.
idea_ch: 验证器驱动的可执行世界模型系统：智能体维护可运行的Python世界模型，通过验证器对比历史观察进行验证，并朝着更简单抽象方向重构（作为MDL简单性偏差的实用替代），在行动前通过模型进行规划。
脚本化控制器框架：包含预定义的世界模型接口、验证器程序和计划执行器，无需手写游戏特定代码，可作为游戏通用基线系统。

title: LongSeeker: Elastic Context Orchestration for Long-Horizon Search Agents
summary: Long-horizon search agents must manage a rapidly growing working context as they reason, call tools, and observe information. Naively accumulating all intermediate content can overwhelm the agent, increasing costs and the risk of errors. We propose that effective context management should be adaptive: parts of the agent's trajectory are maintained at different levels of detail depending on their current relevance to the task. To operationalize this principle, we introduce Context-ReAct, a general agentic paradigm for elastic context orchestration that integrates reasoning, context management, and tool use in a unified loop. Context-ReAct provides five atomic operations: Skip, Compress, Rollback, Snippet and Delete, which allow the agent to dynamically reshape its working context, preserving important evidence, summarizing resolved information, discarding unhelpful branches, and controlling context size. We prove that the Compress operator is expressively complete, while the other specialized operators provide efficiency and fidelity guarantees that reduce generation cost and hallucination risk. Building on this paradigm, we develop LongSeeker, a long-horizon search agent fine-tuned from Qwen3-30B-A3B on 10k synthesized trajectories. Across four representative search benchmarks, LongSeeker achieves 61.5% on BrowseComp and 62.5% on BrowseComp-ZH, substantially outperforming Tongyi DeepResearch (43.2% and 46.7%) and AgentFold (36.2% and 47.3%). These results highlight the potential of adaptive context management, showing that agents can achieve more reliable and efficient long-horizon reasoning by actively shaping their working memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Context-ReAct自适应上下文管理范式，定义五种原子操作，基于该范式开发LongSeeker搜索智能体，在长程搜索基准上大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 长程搜索智能体在推理、工具调用和信息观察过程中，工作上下文会快速增长，简单累积所有中间内容会导致成本增加和错误风险上升，需要自适应的上下文管理机制。
AI.method: 提出Context-ReAct范式，定义五种原子操作（Skip、Compress、Rollback、Snippet、Delete）用于弹性上下文编排；基于该范式开发LongSeeker智能体，在10k合成轨迹上微调Qwen3-30B-A3B模型。
AI.result: LongSeeker在BrowseComp上达61.5%，BrowseComp-ZH上达62.5%，大幅优于Tongyi DeepResearch（43.2%、46.7%）和AgentFold（36.2%、47.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 自适应上下文管理对长程搜索智能体至关重要，Context-ReAct范式和LongSeeker智能体通过动态重塑工作上下文，显著提升了长程推理的可靠性和效率，在多个基准测试中大幅超越现有方法。
